summary: Frontend-only UI/UX verification round for Tennis Tracker (Vite + Tailwind v4, mock localStorage backend) at preview URL. Tested: coach login, header consolidation, notifications bell + dropdown, nav drawer (open/close/active state/sections/navigation), user avatar menu, dashboard, /profile, /history, /aita-rankings, /tournaments, parent login + parent dashboard, theme toggle, mobile 390x844 and desktop 1920 viewports, console/page errors. Core flows work and there are ZERO console/page errors, but three real visual/interaction defects were found - the most important one directly contradicts the 'clean professional header' goal: Tailwind preflight is not imported, so every bare <button> keeps native browser styling (2px outset border + black icon color), and all 23 `bg-gradient-to-*` usages produce NO gradient in Tailwind v4.

ui_bugs.issue: Tailwind preflight/base is never imported (only `tailwindcss/theme` and `tailwindcss/utilities`). Result: computed style of header buttons is `border: 2px outset rgb(0,0,0)`, `appearance: auto`, `color: rgb(0,0,0)`. So (a) menu-toggle-btn and theme-toggle-btn icons render BLACK on the near-black header (stroke rgb(0,0,0) vs header bg oklab(0.145...)) - practically invisible; (b) every icon button/tab chip shows a native grey outset box (visible on drawer close X, 'Light mode', 'Download Guide PDF', Coach page tab chips). Fix: add `@import "tailwindcss/preflight" layer(base);` (or at minimum add explicit `text-foreground border-0 appearance-none` to these buttons).

ui_bugs.component: Gradients app-wide (AppShell avatar, ProfilePage hero, DashboardPage cards, MatchHistoryPage, player tabs)
ui_bugs.issue: All `bg-gradient-to-br/-r` classes compute to `background-image: none` on Tailwind v4.3.x (renamed to `bg-linear-to-*`). Verified 6 elements on Dashboard + AppShell avatar. Consequence: user avatar button falls back to the native buttonface colour rgb(239,239,239) with white text (`CR` / `M(` unreadable, contrast ~1.1:1), profile hero avatar is an empty ring, 'gradient' stat/streak cards are flat. 23 occurrences across 10 files.

On 390px mobile the 320px-wide dropdown anchored `right-0` overflows the left viewport edge (bounding box x = -38) so the 'Notifications' title is clipped ('tifications'). Needs mobile-safe positioning (e.g. fixed left-2 right-2 w-auto on small screens).
Initials logic `displayName.split(/\s+/).map(n=>n[0])` produces 'M(' for the parent demo user (name contains a parenthesis). Should strip non-alphanumerics.

integration_issues.flow: Close notifications / user dropdown by clicking outside
integration_issues.issue: Outside click does NOT close either dropdown. The `fixed inset-0 z-40` scrim is a child of the header, and the header uses `backdrop-blur-sm` (backdrop-filter) which makes the header a containing block for fixed-position descendants -> the scrim only covers the 64px header strip. Verified: with the dropdown open, document.elementFromPoint(200,700) returns page content (not the scrim), the dropdown stays open after an outside click, and Playwright's click on [data-testid="menu-toggle-btn"] is blocked for 30s by '<div class="fixed inset-0 z-40"> intercepts pointer events'. So while a dropdown is open the header controls are unclickable and the only way to close it is tapping inside the header area. Fix: render the scrim via portal / move it outside the backdrop-blur header, or use an outside-click hook.

issues: Hamburger and theme icons black on dark background - invisible/very low contrast
Native outset borders around icon buttons look unpolished
Avatar chip renders light-grey with white initials (unreadable) due to broken gradient
Gradient hero + streak/stat card gradients do not render (flat cards, hollow avatar ring) so the enhancement is not visible to the user

action_items: Import Tailwind preflight (`@import "tailwindcss/preflight" layer(base);`) in src/styles/app-tailwind.css, or explicitly reset border/appearance/color on all bare <button> elements - this is the root cause of the 'ugly' header the user reported.
Replace all 23 `bg-gradient-to-*` classes with Tailwind v4 `bg-linear-to-*` (or explicit bg-primary) - gradients currently render as nothing; verify avatar/profile hero.
Move the dropdown outside-click scrim out of the backdrop-blur header (or use a portal / outside-click hook) so notifications & user menus close on outside click and don't block header buttons.
Make the notifications dropdown mobile-safe (no left-edge overflow at 390px).
Sanitize avatar initials (strip non-alphanumeric chars) - parent shows 'M('.
critical_code_review_comments: app-tailwind.css deliberately skips preflight; without it Tailwind utilities like bg-transparent do not neutralise UA button styling. Any component relying on inherited `color` will render black.

AppShell/NotificationsBell duplicate the same dropdown+scrim pattern; extract a shared Popover primitive (Radix is already a dependency) to avoid the fixed-inside-backdrop-filter bug repeating (TopNav.jsx has the same backdrop-blur header).

Verified working: nav drawer sections (MENU/PREFERENCES), active item highlight (rgb(51,112,255) with white text), role-based nav items for coach/parent, drawer navigation + auto-close, all tap targets >= 40px, no horizontal scroll on any tested page, no console errors.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Login testids were added by T1: login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit-btn. Pages verified empty-state only (no matches/tournaments/rankings data in mock store). After logout the app returns to the last protected route on next login (expected ProtectedRoute behaviour, not a bug) - navigate to '/' explicitly to see the parent dashboard. Re-verify: (1) button border/icon colour after preflight fix, (2) bg-linear-to-* gradients render, (3) outside-click closes both dropdowns and header buttons remain clickable, (4) notifications dropdown fits within 390px.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Missing Tailwind preflight -> UA stylesheet supplies `border:2px outset` + `color: buttontext(black)` + `appearance:auto` for bare buttons, causing invisible header icons and grey native chips. 2) Tailwind v4 renamed gradient utilities to `bg-linear-to-*`; the legacy `bg-gradient-to-*` classes emit no CSS, so avatar/hero gradients silently disappear and the avatar falls back to native buttonface grey. 3) `backdrop-blur-sm` on the sticky header creates a containing block for `position: fixed` descendants, confining the dropdown scrim to the header box - hence outside clicks don't close dropdowns while the scrim simultaneously blocks the header buttons.
